abilities.effect: A shimmering mote of violet light flashes from the point of origin from the triggering action, unerringly striking the triggering creature. This bolt of agony deals 10d10 mental damage (DC 30 basic Fortitude save).
abilities.name: Emit Agnoy

traits.name: Divine
traits.text:
This magic comes from the divine tradition, drawing power from deities or similar sources. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to divine magic.

traits.name: Necromancy
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the necromancy school of magic, typically involving forces of life and death.

abilities.trigger: The crystallized agony is struck hard enough to take damage

hazard.description: A violet crystal containing the body of a dead creature, grown from its dying agony, pulses as it exudes motes of flickering energy.
hazard.disable: DC 33 Thievery (master) or DC 35 Survival (master) to know where to Strike a specific crystal perfectly on a facet to cause it to shatter harmlessly
hazard.name: Crystalized Agony
hazard.reset: A crystallized agony resets automatically and can be triggered again the next round.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
